Elon Musk's X posts focus on UK issues over SpaceX IPO

Analysis of Elon Musk's social media activity reveals a significant focus on UK race and immigration issues, with posts on these topics outnumbering those about SpaceX in the lead-up to its potential IPO. This has drawn attention from investors concerned about SpaceX's association with Musk's public statements. The coverage highlights the intersection of Musk's business interests and his outspoken online presence.
